parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal statute, but morality/indecency Articles 324, 329, 350 carry 3 months-2 years and deportation for non-citizens, documented used against cross-dressing/LGBTQI+ people (2009 jail for abaya/purse; 2011 raid). Entry screening targets suspected effeminate homosexuals, with pending entry-ban bills. No discrimination protection, hate speech unpunished, organisations barred, further moral legislation Feb 2024, and thin/blocked research. Presentation at border or in public can trigger arrest, detention and removal with no documented remedy.

entry_documents.exposure: Interior Minister: suspected effeminate homosexuals banned via airport checks; indecency provisions allow deportation; pending bills to bar LGBTQ foreigners entry/residency. Courts require operation/medical necessity for marker change, so mismatch is salient.
entry_documents.protection: Not documented. No traveller-facing protection for foreign documents, X markers or presentation described.
entry_documents.interaction: Document/presentation mismatch at airport can become indecency investigation, detention and deportation - entry is documented primary vector.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Arrest under Articles 324,329,350 (3mo-2yr, fines to 200 units); 2009 one-month jail for cross-dressing; 2011 party raid. Article 330 mandates hospital STD testing/medical relocation for prostitution/fujoor charges.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No bail, legal-aid, consular or complaint remedy for visitors described.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for presentation leads to custody and, for non-citizens, deportation; medical-facility transfer adds forced outing/examination risk.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No LGBTQ-specific facilities/shelters; no subnational variation documented. State-level law/courts/ministries only; facilities presumably by legal sex/sex assigned, but specific bathroom/ward rule not documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Absence of inclusive facilities plus indecency enforcement makes public facilities a risk surface, but exact facility rule is uncertain.

care_services.exposure: May 2023 court rejected trans man's gender-affirming healthcare citing Sharia and refused ministry examination; 2023 ruling limits reassignment to intersex traits, not dysphoria alone. Article 330 compulsory hospital testing on related charges.
care_services.protection: Not documented for visitors: no hormone continuity, emergency-care or non-discrimination guarantee described.
care_services.interaction: Seeking care can out visitor and intersect with criminal/medical referral; resident healthcare denial is climate signal, traveller exposure is forced medical process on charge.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Police use indecency/debauchery provisions against queer/trans and cross-dressing people; further moral legislation adopted Feb 2024; false homosexuality accusations used to discredit critics; hate speech against LGBTQ+ has no consequences.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Not documented. No anti-discrimination or hate-crime protection for sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or sex characteristics.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Unpunished hostility plus active morality enforcement gives officials social license and legal lever; state frames gender nonconformity as indecency.

minors_guardians.exposure: Youth explicit target: pending bills to train teachers to spot homosexuality/cross-dressing to punish children and criminalise promotion (to 5 years); Education Ministry says students whose appearance contradicts school values should be disciplined; Feb 2024 school board investigated/dismissed after mock proposal video.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented. No traveller-facing protection for minors or guardians described; pending bills not confirmed enacted.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor's presentation, or adult guardian's, risks disciplinary/indecency scrutiny and forced outing to family/institutions, though border-specific minor rule is not documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific violence/killing rate with denominator documented. Police are perpetrators of raids/arrests for presentation, not documented protectors; 2024 newspaper caricature hostile.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Not documented. No evidence police protect trans victims; hate speech unpunished.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Documented police targeting outweighs undocumented street-violence rate; absence of rate is not safety given blocked researchers.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No remedy, appeal, ombuds or legal-aid mechanism for visitors documented. Researchers blocked a decade; 1976 decriminalisation vs 2016 illegality claim conflict unresolved; Feb 2024 law details, 2013 testing status, pending bills status unknown.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved legal status plus no recourse means visitor cannot predict whether indecency arrest, entry ban or deportation will follow discovery.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: morality/indecency provision applied selectively to trans presentation, short jail/fines, fragmented evidence, no capital threat. Our case also has explicit entry ban for effeminate visitors, pushing similar or slightly lower.

Higher safety: police stop, confiscate, fine and release after hours, imprisonment rare, courts formally accept complaints. Our documented 1-month jail, up-to-2-year statute and deportation for non-citizens is materially more severe.

Much higher safety: extended secondary screening, discretionary refusal, slow appeal, but normally administrative not criminal. Our case involves criminal arrest for cross-dressing and entry ban, well below 0.55.

parsed.synthesis: Combined operative regime is state-level only, no protective subnational layer. 1976 sodomy repeal does not remove exposure because indecency law supplies arrest, jail and deportation powers used against gender nonconformity, and border checks explicitly target effeminate presentation. No anti-discrimination, facility, care or complaint protection is documented to offset this tier-2 state targeting. Thin data and unresolved decriminalisation conflict extrapolate toward risk, not neutrality: structural signals are active morality enforcement, Sharia-based denial, no organisations, and institutional hostility to youth. Custodial torture or capital punishment is not documented, keeping score above 0.15.
